snippet.title: 🔧 Garage: Tidy Up! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🔧 Garage: Tidy Up! — Play now on Steam!

Garage: Tidy Up! is a cozy first-person organizing simulator where you restore order in a messy auto workshop. Sort tools, parts, paint cans, fasteners, license plates, and garage supplies into their proper places, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into the perfect dream garage.
